name: release
title_zh: 发布一次，版本号、官网、流水线全自动对齐
tagline_zh: 不再手动翻 CHANGELOG 猜下一个版本号，也不用记着先改官网再跑流水线。它替你算好、改好、推好，你只管点发布。
tagline_en: Stop guessing the next version or remembering to update the site first. It derives, edits, and triggers—you just.
desc_en: Determine the next version, update the marketing site, and run the full release pipeline.
why_zh: 把版本决策从「人拍脑袋」变成「仓库现状推导」，并强制官网与发布动作同一次完成，杜绝版本与宣传脱节。
why_en: Turns version bumping from gut feel into repo-state logic, and couples site update with the release action so marketing never.
limit_zh: 只认语义化版本（SemVer），且仓库需已有规范 tag 历史；官网内容必须由仓库内文件生成，否则它改不到线上。
limit_en: SemVer only, needs clean tag history; site must be generated from repo files. Ends at pipeline trigger—no post-deploy checks.
title_en: One release run: version, site, and pipeline aligned
